items.title: Renew Birmingham business license
items.authority: City of Birmingham Finance Department, Tax and License Administration Division
items.description: Businesses in Birmingham need a city business license. The license year runs January 1 to December 31 and licenses expire on December 31.

items.title: Renew Huntsville business license
items.description: Licenses expire December 31; renewal is due January 31, a 15% penalty applies from February 1 and 30% from March 1 (insurance licenses are due the last day of February).

items.title: Renew Mobile business license
items.description: Licenses expire December 31, are due January 1 and become delinquent after January 31; a 15% penalty applies in February and 30% from March 1.

items.title: Renew Montgomery business license
items.authority: City of Montgomery License and Revenue Division
items.description: Licenses expire December 31. The city sets the penalty-free renewal date each year (February 2 for 2026) with a 15% penalty after and 30% a month later; city tax accounts must be current.
items.deadline: Set by the city each year (late January or early February)
